name: 83014 · Wilson, WY
findings: ZIP 83014 (Wilson) has 20 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Foundation organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (60% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 83014 (Wilson) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 8 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
